title: sow_conformance_verdict
description: Verdict for one semantic criterion graded against one call.

criterionId.description: The criterion this verdict is for, echoed back verbatim.

verdict.description: not_applicable when the call never reached the situation the criterion governs — e.g. a scheduling criterion on a call where no visit was discussed. Do not use it to avoid a hard call.

confidence.description: How confident the verdict is, between 0 and 1 inclusive.

severity.description: Consequence for the caller and the site if this failure stands. Safety exposure and unlogged faults are critical; wording and style issues are low. Only meaningful when verdict is fail.

summary.description: One or two sentences stating what went wrong, naming the caller and the fault. Written for a supervisor who has not read the transcript.

evidence.description: The specific turns that justify the verdict. Quote the transcript; never paraphrase into something the caller did not say. Empty when verdict is pass.

at.description: Timestamp offset of the turn, as it appears in the transcript.

who.description: Who produced this turn: Caller, Agent, Tool call, System, or CMMS.

isViolation.description: True if this turn is where the criterion was broken, false if it is supporting context.
